# Played & Made — Life in Games (Played&Made)

> Interactive personal video game timeline builder, 4251-game historical lineage tree, game lore & deep-cuts trivia, and tribute to the human makers, studios, and hardware engineers behind video games.

Canonical URL: https://playedmade.com/
Author: Johan Heurlin

## Core Capabilities & Sections
- **Personal Gaming Timeline (#timeline & #picks)**: Build a year-by-year childhood or game-industry career timeline across 71 consoles, home computers, and regional platforms (including Amiga, Commodore 64, NES, Dendy, Subor, Sharp X68000, NEC PC-98, Vectrex, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and PC), with shareable serverless links and PNG cards.
- **Video Game Family Tree (#tree)**: Trace 4251 games and 2834 primary-source inspiration links from 1950s lab mainframes and tabletop wargames to modern releases, documenting what each studio built on and what it added.
- **Daily Play — Game Lore Trivia & 12-Wedge Lucky Wheel (#daily)**: 6-mode interactive quiz covering Deep-Cut Gaming & Industry Lore, Lineage, Launch Year, Studio, Country, and System, alongside Today's Rabbit Hole and a physics-driven 12-wedge Lucky Wheel.
- **Almanac — Vault, Mods, Mobile, Prices, Studios & World Map (#almanac, #vault, #mods, #mobile, #prices, #studios, #world)**: Honors unshipped developer craft (Project Titan -> Overwatch, Van Buren -> Fallout: New Vegas, Star Wars 1313, Silent Hills, Thrill Kill -> Wu-Tang: Shaolin Style, Star Fox 2), sunsetted online worlds (Glitch -> Slack, Chromehounds, Star Wars Galaxies, City of Heroes, Echo VR, Knockout City), strange-but-true gaming folklore (Gizmondo, Atari's Alamogordo New Mexico cartridge dig, TecToy Brazil, Sega Channel, Satellaview, Desert Bus), 16 core mechanics, 30 genres, 14 tabletop roots, 1977–2026 CPI-adjusted prices, 75 studios, 35 pioneers, 26 hardware engineering teams, 46 countries, and downloadable Thank-You Postcards for game developers.
